quantum.hero_sub: Arc is building blockchain infrastructure that protects against future quantum computing threats, ensuring institutional assets remain secure for decades to come.
quantum.info: Quantum readiness status is reported by validators and manually verified by the ArcGov team. Arc Testnet does not publish a real-time quantum upgrade API. Data is updated when validators confirm milestone completions.
quantum.why_p1: Traditional blockchain security relies on elliptic curve cryptography (ECC). Quantum computers, specifically using Shor's algorithm, threaten these systems by solving the underlying mathematical problems exponentially faster than classical computers. This means private keys could eventually be derived from public addresses, compromising the entire network's immutability.
quantum.why_p2: Post-quantum cryptography (PQC) involves mathematical algorithms that are believed to be secure against both quantum and classical computers. Arc is proactively investing in these standards—like CRYSTALS-Dilithium—to harden our network before the "Q-Day" threat becomes reality, ensuring total security for the world's stablecoin infrastructure.
quantum.phase1_desc: Validators upgrade signing keys to quantum-resistant algorithms (CRYSTALS-Dilithium) to secure administrative actions.
quantum.phase2_desc: Integration of post-quantum encryption standards for account balances and transaction metadata.
quantum.phase3_desc: Upgrading the consensus layer block production signatures to be fully quantum-resistant.
quantum.phase4_desc: End-to-end quantum security across all Arc protocol layers and institutional bridge infrastructure.
quantum.subscribe_desc: Get notified when validators complete quantum upgrade milestones.

about.title: About ArcGov
about.p1: ArcGov is the first community-built governance and validator dashboard designed specifically for the Arc blockchain. Our mission is to provide transparency and accessibility to the network's most critical decision-making processes.
about.p2: We built ArcGov before Circle even needed it—believing that community-owned infrastructure is vital for the long-term health of the Arc ecosystem. We provide the tools for builders and users to track network health and shape its future.
about.p3: ArcGov is independent and non-commercial. We are not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Circle Internet Financial Ltd.
about.arc_p1: Circle built Arc as a stablecoin-native Layer-1 blockchain, engineered from the ground up to support the world's most trusted digital assets with institutional-grade security and scale.
about.arc_p2: Arc uses USDC as the native gas token, eliminating the volatility of traditional gas fees. It features sub-second finality and is fully EVM compatible, making it the perfect environment for global payment protocols and DeFi applications.
about.arc_p3: The network is secured by a diverse set of institutional validators and is following an ambitious quantum-resistant roadmap, ensuring that assets on Arc remain protected against future cryptographic threats.

about.faq_q1: Is ArcGov the official Arc governance site?
about.faq_a1: No. ArcGov is an independent community-built dashboard. We are not affiliated with Circle or the official Arc team.
about.faq_q2: Do I need tokens to vote on proposals?
about.faq_a2: On testnet: any wallet can vote for free. At mainnet launch: Arc tokens will be required for weighted voting on protocol changes.
about.faq_q3: How do I get testnet USDC for gas?
about.faq_a3: Visit faucet.circle.com, select Arc Testnet, enter your wallet address, and you will receive 10 testnet USDC free of charge.
about.faq_q4: What is the Arc Testnet chain ID?
about.faq_a4: The chain ID is 5042002. You can add this to MetaMask under Settings → Networks using the RPC URL: https://rpc.testnet.arc.network
about.faq_a5: On testnet, they serve as signal votes for the community. At mainnet with the native Arc token, passed proposals can trigger automated on-chain execution.
about.faq_q6: How do validators get added to Arc?
about.faq_a6: Circle approves validators directly based on strict criteria including compliance, security standards, and jurisdictional diversity.
about.faq_a7: Post-quantum cryptography protects against future quantum computers that could break current encryption. Arc is proactively upgrading its entire infrastructure.
about.faq_q8: How do I build on Arc?
about.faq_a8: Visit docs.arc.network for comprehensive developer documentation, tutorials, and technical RPC details for building your own dApps.
